confirm.resetSchool:
Reset {{name}}'s school to the starting room?

Every room they bought is removed and their wallpaper, floor, layout and per-room presets go back to the defaults. Currency is not refunded, and this cannot be undone.
confirm.resetIntro:
Show the intro to {{name}} again?

Their two answers are cleared, and on their next visit they go through the questions and the method slides before anything else. Progress and wallet are not touched.
